title: CODATA 2022: the electron charge-to-mass quotient is −1.758 820 008 38 × 10¹¹ C/kg
summary: The standard uncertainty is 0.000 000 000 55 × 10¹¹ C/kg. The sign is negative because the electron's charge is negative.
body: The NIST 2022 listing prints 'electron charge to mass quotient −1.758 820 008 38 e11' with standard uncertainty '0.000 000 000 55 e11', unit C kg⁻¹. It also prints 'electron gyromag. ratio in MHz/T 28 024.951 3861' with standard uncertainty '0.000 0087' MHz T⁻¹. Both are derived from the electron's charge and mass in this adjustment. Neither is marked exact.
